# Rules

- Keep responses short and to the point.
- Deploy with `scripts/deploy-legacy.sh`.
- If you judge that a request is a side quest, write it down, ask the user, then return to the main task.
- Since PR #123 (2026-03-02) we use pnpm; it measured 40% faster than npm.
- Never ask the user questions; always proceed with your best guess.
- Use pnpm for all package scripts.
